describes: Exception cues (exception_ in deontic.ebnf, a sibling constituent of modal_frame, never nested inside it) and the content markers that classify the exception clause once found. 'in accordance with Article N' and similar cross-references are deliberately NOT resolved (no resolver is built): xref_markers and external_terms only classify the clause as one of EXCEPTION_XREF_UNRESOLVED / EXCEPTION_EXTERNAL_UNRESOLVED / internal_parsed, matched by simple membership over the exception clause's words, never by a compiled pattern.
